focus.title: 欧盟拟于2026年底前实施碳边境调节机制过渡期细则，出口企业需提前布局碳核算
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会近期公布碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期实施细则草案，明确2026年10月起进口商需申报嵌入排放数据，2027年正式征收碳关税。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等高碳出口行业面临成本上升压力。企业应尽快建立产品级碳核算体系，对接欧盟认可的第三方核查机构，优化供应链低碳转型，以降低合规风险与贸易成本。
focus.title_en: EU Unveils CBAM Transitional Rules for Late 2026; Exporters Urged to Prepare Carbon Accounting
focus.summary_en: The European Commission recently published draft implementing rules for the CBAM transitional period, requiring importers to report embedded emissions from October 2026 and imposing carbon levies from 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminum, and fertilizers face rising costs. Companies should establish product-level carbon accounting, engage EU-recognized verifiers, and pursue low-carbon supply chain improvements to mitigate compliance risks.

case.title: 最高法发布跨境知识产权典型案例：强调惩罚性赔偿适用与证据妨碍规则
case.summary: 最高人民法院近期发布一批跨境知识产权典型案例，其中涉及中国企业与外方合作中的商业秘密侵权纠纷。法院认定被告恶意毁损证据，适用证据妨碍规则推定侵权成立，并依情节适用惩罚性赔偿，判赔金额显著提高。该案提示出海企业应重视境内外证据保全策略，完善保密协议与竞业限制条款，以应对跨国知识产权纠纷中的举证难题。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院官网 · 2026年9月
case.title_en: SPC Releases Typical Cross-Border IP Cases: Punitive Damages and Evidence Spoliation Rules Highlighted
case.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court recently issued typical cross-border IP cases, including a trade secret dispute between a Chinese company and a foreign partner. The court applied adverse inference due to willful evidence destruction, upheld infringement, and granted enhanced punitive damages. This signals that Chinese enterprises should strengthen evidence preservation strategies and robust confidentiality/non-compete clauses to handle cross-border IP disputes.
case.source_en: Source: Supreme People's Court website · September 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业合规路径更清晰
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室等发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理措施（试行）》，为区内企业提供标准合同、认证与安全评估等便捷通道。新规明确个人与重要数据的跨境清单管理，降低中小企业合规成本。出海企业应利用该机制优化数据跨境安排，同时关注国家网信办后续配套指引，确保数据出境安全与业务连续性。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in GBA Take Effect, Offering Clearer Compliance Paths
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province issued the 'Pilot Measures for Cross-Border Data Flow Security Management in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area', providing streamlined channels such as standard contracts, certification, and security assessments. The rules clarify the list-based management of personal and important data, reducing compliance costs for SMEs. Companies should leverage this mechanism to optimize data transfers and monitor follow-up national guidelines.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · Sep 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国出口管制新规下，中国企业应重构合规筛查与供应链韧性
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部近期升级对华半导体设备与AI芯片出口管制，实体清单新增多家中国实体，并扩大外国直接产品规则适用范围。中国出海企业，尤其科技行业，需重构出口管制合规筛查体系，包括终端用户审查、产品技术参数比对及供应链穿透核查。建议建立动态合规数据库，与专业机构合作开展内审，并制定应急替代方案以增强供应链韧性。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Under New US Export Controls, Chinese Firms Should Rebuild Compliance Screening and Supply Chain Resilience
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Department of Commerce recently escalated export controls on semiconductor equipment and AI chips to China, adding Chinese entities to the Entity List and expanding the Foreign Direct Product Rule. Chinese enterprises, especially in tech, must rebuild export control compliance screening, including end-user checks, technical parameter comparisons, and supply chain due diligence. Recommend establishing dynamic compliance databases, conducting internal audits with experts, and devising contingency plans to enhance supply chain resilience.
